note: Clinical means BRIGHT and FLAT, not blue: brightness and gamma up, contrast just under 1 so there is nowhere for shadow to hide, and the cool cast confined to highlights so whites go slightly cyan (input 192 -> 219,226,227) the way overlit white walls do. Red pulled a touch from shadows to drain warmth out of skin. Distinct from fluorescent, which is the sickly green version of the same room.
